# Answer to `generator-shortcuts`

The strongest plausible canonical-fitting rival I found is
**`homogeneous_orientation_only`**:

> Fill every opposite-corner bounding rectangle only when all color pairs in
> the scene have the same diagonal orientation; if a scene mixes NW→SE and
> NE→SW pairs, leave it unchanged.

This is stronger than the simpler `main_diagonal_only` rival because it behaves
correctly on both all-NW→SE and all-NE→SW scenes. It fits all 5/5 usable
canonical pairs: every canonical scene is orientation-homogeneous (and in fact
all of its pairs are NW→SE).

An exact disagreeing input emitted by the final generator is the ordinary
`medium` draw with `seed=424242`, `sample_index=1`, and no overrides. Each digit
below is one grid cell:

```text
00000030000000
00300000000000
00000000000000
00000000000000
10000000000000
00000000000000
00000100000000
00000000000000
00000000000060
00000000006000
00000000000000
```

The scene has three rectangles: one NW→SE pair and two NE→SW pairs. The intended
rule fills all three inclusive bounding boxes; the rival returns the sparse input
unchanged. Their first disagreement is `(row=0,col=2)`, where the authoritative
output is `3` and the rival output is `0`.

I checked this in three independent steps. First, the generator's structural
validator returned `[]` and its semantic profile reported `1` main-diagonal and
`2` anti-diagonal pairs. Second, an independent Python bounding-box mirror
disagreed with the rival. Third, the supported Racket command
`arcpuzzles apply` produced the same result as the mirror with executed rule hash
`d273f364d771`; input SHA-256 is
`cec7714287583259a0105a9f094f4cf5b2e195719ed7f53138f9f3db6a5df7ec`.
The complete input and outputs are retained in
`checks/question/generator-shortcuts/`.

Yes, the proposed generator deliberately emits such cases. Every
`anti_diagonal_counterexample` profile now mixes orientations. On final source
SHA-256 `bec34c6fa7ad1c7930222894ffe4d339077bc0a9ac85b90bccc0e2f2aca1ddd2`,
the semantic gate observed the mixed-orientation witness in 303/600 draws, and
the source-bound census refuted this rival in 100/100 lessons in each of easy,
medium, and hard. The final generator also retains and refutes the weaker
`main_diagonal_only` rival.
